hints.title: Bottom-Right to Top-Left Traversal
hints.text: Movement is allowed only up, left, and diagonally up-left. Work backwards from (n-1, n-1) to (0, 0).

hints.title: Two Value DP State
hints.text: For cell (r, c), store a pair: (maximum path score, count of paths achieving that score modulo 10^9 + 7).

hints.title: Aggregate Over Three Predecessors
hints.text: Inspect (r+1, c), (r, c+1), and (r+1, c+1). Take the max score among reachable neighbors and sum path counts that match.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive path enumeration without memoization has exponential branching factor 3^(2N).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dynamic programming table tracks best score and path multiplicity in quadratic space and time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles modular arithmetic and ties in maximum score correctly.
complexity.notes: Modulo 10^9 + 7 applies to path counts, not path scores.
